svg.aria-label: How the app works: your devices and cameras feed Home Assistant inside your home. Online services such as weather, flights and news come in over the internet. Home Assistant serves the dashboard page, which saves and loads what people enter, with versions, Undo and a copy every night. The dashboard shows on wall tablets, TVs and computers. Phones, the watch and the car are reached through the phone apps, and alerts to them travel over the internet.
